problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a circuit of maintenance checks across nine critical infrastructure nodes:
Node Alpha: Positioned at grid reference (123,99)
Node Beta: Positioned at grid reference (155,150)
Node Gamma: Positioned at grid reference (59,5)
Node Delta: Positioned at grid reference (168,0)
Node Epsilon: Positioned at grid reference (189,46)
Node Zeta: Positioned at grid reference (77,129)
Node Eta: Positioned at grid reference (145,65)
Node Theta: Positioned at grid reference (85,16)
Node Iota: Positioned at grid reference (126,67)

The travel durations between nodes, measured in minutes, are as follows:
Alpha to Gamma: 113.7 min
Alpha to Delta: 108.7 min
Alpha to Epsilon: 84.6 min
Alpha to Zeta: 54.9 min
Alpha to Eta: 40.5 min
Alpha to Theta: 91.3 min
Alpha to Iota: 32.1 min
Beta to Gamma: 173.9 min
Beta to Delta: 150.6 min
Beta to Epsilon: 109.4 min
Beta to Zeta: 80.8 min
Beta to Eta: 85.6 min
Beta to Theta: 151.2 min
Beta to Iota: 87.9 min
Gamma to Delta: 109.1 min
Gamma to Epsilon: 136.3 min
Gamma to Zeta: 125.3 min
Gamma to Eta: 104.9 min
Gamma to Theta: 28.2 min
Gamma to Iota: 91.3 min
Delta to Epsilon: 50.6 min
Delta to Zeta: 157.9 min
Delta to Eta: 68.9 min
Delta to Theta: 84.5 min
Delta to Iota: 79.1 min
Epsilon to Zeta: 139.4 min
Epsilon to Eta: 47.9 min
Epsilon to Theta: 108.2 min
Epsilon to Iota: 66.4 min
Zeta to Eta: 93.4 min
Zeta to Theta: 113.3 min
Zeta to Iota: 79.0 min
Eta to Theta: 77.5 min
Eta to Iota: 19.1 min
Theta to Iota: 65.4 min

Due to a permanent service restriction, no direct connection exists between Node Alpha and Node Beta.
Furthermore, the routing plan must mandatorily incorporate precisely one of the following two critical links: the conduit between Node Beta and Node Gamma, or the conduit between Node Gamma and Node Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal-duration inspection loop that visits every node exactly once and concludes at the origin point.
